In the excerpt of the `getNextCPIOEntry` method, the logic identifies different types of CPIO entries based on magic strings and processes them accordingly. Notably, it handles `CPIO_TRAILER` specially, setting `entryEOF` to true and skipping the remainder of the last block when the entry name matches `CPIO_TRAILER`.

Given the reported issue related to a non-zero file mode on the trailer causing an `IllegalArgumentException`, there could be a potential discrepancy in how the trailer entry is handled within the `getNextCPIOEntry` method. Further investigation into this method, particularly the processing of trailer entries, might reveal insights into why the exception occurs when reading CPIO archives created by Redline RPM.

To pinpoint the exact location or condition triggering the `IllegalArgumentException`, it would be beneficial to review how the `CPIO_TRAILER` entry and its associated file mode are handled in the `getNextCPIOEntry` method.
